name: tile-pilot-reused-data-research-v1
notes: Preserve prepared image resolution; no resizing after cropping.
Source data were previously explored. Split discipline does not make this independent external validation or preregistration.
1600 distinct source identities selected across balanced real/AI domains; remaining sources are unused.
600 calibration and 600 test images permit useful 1% FPR assessment, but passing remains data-dependent.
FPR assurance is pooled over the selected source-domain mixture; domain-specific intervals are exploratory.
All method thresholds use maxima across crop conditions per null source image; crop rows are not independent trials.
One final evaluation only. A failed or inconclusive final result does not authorize retuning against the test split.

ICISC reuse: the fixed 48-bit XL payload (payload_source), the ICISC crop rule with rounded sizes and filename-hash seeds (evaluation.crop_rule; area 0.5 is a new condition under the same rule) and the legacy delta-36 raster insertions as an insertion cache (reuse) replace the seeded random payload, the runner crop rule and fresh raster insertions. Every detection row is a new decode; legacy none/0.8 results stay historical reference and are never mixed into the H1-H3 raw. The *_expected_sha256 values are declared at P03 and compared with the hashes the runner pins at prepare.

R04 compared 8 development sources pixel by pixel (delta-36 insertion, crop boxes, crop pixels, stored bits). That is evidence, not proof, of equivalence for all sources; a source whose conditions do not hold is embedded anew and the reason is recorded per row.
